narrative.text: Merchant MID100132 declared travel_agency at onboarding 383 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the travel_agency baseline are round_share_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 0.554 against a category baseline of -8e-05), velocity_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 1.05 against a category baseline of 0.00307), velocity_recent at +6.4 sigma (observed 2.54 against a category baseline of 1.62). The checkout surface is consistent with the declared travel_agency category (0.17 confidence). In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is analyst review with settlements continuing, because only one view dissents. A model is 0.97 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
